method: Independent Fraction/integer bound calculation, no production helper invocation or source mutation
conservative_seed_explanation: First promotion follows at least two observations; at most three finite seed terms plus remaining <=N-2 inputs gives <=N+1 terms
bound_condition: Internal previous/correction/input seed terms finite binary64. It is a representation bound, not accuracy/rounding/heap proof.
limitations: No V8 object heap size measured; CPython object size cannot justify V8 header/allocator cost. 512B retained charge is not an RSS cap. Conversion temporaries and caller inputs are extra. Safe count maximum not physically exercised.
